speaker: Doctor
text: Hello, I am Dr. Agent. You mentioned you are experiencing fatigue, flank pain, and fever after recently taking antibiotics for sinusitis. Can you describe the nature of the flank pain and whether you have noticed any changes in your urine, such as color or frequency?

speaker: Patient
text: I have been feeling tired, feverish, and I have flank pain. These symptoms continued even after my sinus symptoms improved.

speaker: Doctor
text: The persistence of fever and flank pain despite the resolution of your sinusitis is concerning for a secondary infection, possibly involving the kidneys. Do you experience any pain or burning when you urinate, or have you noticed any blood in your urine?

speaker: Patient
text: I was first treated with amoxicillin for sinusitis and developed a rash. Then the antibiotic was changed to cephalexin for another week, and the rash went away.

speaker: Doctor
text: The development of a rash on amoxicillin followed by fever and flank pain after switching to cephalexin strongly suggests Acute Interstitial Nephritis (AIN). Do you have any current urinary symptoms like increased frequency or urgency, and have you noticed any swelling in your legs or face?

speaker: Patient
text: I do not have nausea, vomiting, or burning with urination. I also have not noticed a major change in urine color.

speaker: Doctor
text: Thank you for confirming those details; the absence of dysuria and hematuria further supports a diagnosis of Acute Interstitial Nephritis rather than a typical urinary tract infection. I will now request laboratory tests to evaluate your kidney function and look for signs of inflammation. REQUEST TEST: Basic_Metabolic_Panel, Urinalysis, Urine_Sediment_Microscopy
